confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mumbai price levels, not live listings or current menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel rates are less certain because they vary by season and location, and July is monsoon season. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weak. Conversions assume roughly INR 90 per USD. The FX observation is the RBA 16 October 2026 USD_PER_AUD figure from search results, not verified on the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Indian metro price levels (Delhi and Bengaluru) with a Mumbai premium for hotels and bar drinks. No web research was used for the city-price anchors.
